defined.name: overbought_fade
defined.when: h1_stoch_k > 80 and h1_stoch_ch2 < 0 and h1_MACD_STATE == 'bull narrowing'

prereg.idea: heavy volume on the 1h and 15m bars comes before up-moves in futures and crypto too
prereg.entry: buy the future or the coin at the 1h close on the first bar of each volume_surge signal
prereg.exit: sell when price turns 0.75 day-ATR off its best point since entry, or after 5 trading days
prereg.measure: median move in day-ATRs and win rate for signal entries vs all bars, in each half
prereg.pass_mark: signal median move at least +0.5 day-ATR and win rate above 55% in both halves
prereg.label: C_2atr
